alternatives.name: Unconditional removal
alternatives.reason: Reachable Boolean equivalence is true, but changes the explicit frozen private stale-tag injection contract. Do not remove the comparator or old test unconditionally.

assertions: certified valid implies full tag equality
each real birth captures current tag, valid1, certificate1 on the same edge
every real birth is consumed on exactly the original producer-kill edge, not merely ignored
certificate clears on command_accept/reset and cannot be created by a stale private valid injection
certificate cannot authorize a new sequence; command_pending delivery and accepted/delivered/canceled conservation unchanged
alternatives.dataflow: Keep existing base_kill_valid and base_kill_owner observable. Add a small certificate set atomically at both real kill births, held after valid falls, cleared on reset and command_accept. Drive base_abort=abort_packet||(base_kill_valid&&certificate). Preserve immediate public mask, accepted response drain and original kill edge.
alternatives.limits: Not generic recovery from arbitrary private tag/certificate corruption. A forged valid with a corrupted tag while an old held certificate remains1 could pass the certificate; an assertion would detect it in simulation but is not silicon recovery. Define reachable-transition/declared injection contract explicitly. Do not market equivalent arbitrary-state fault tolerance.
alternatives.name: Held registered authorization certificate; no extra kill edge
alternatives.old_stale_probe: b.offer accepts the new command and clears certificate. Its subsequent private stale valid/owner injection has certificate0 and remains ignored. Add explicit pre-edge !base_abort and child-ownership checks without deleting the existing oracle.
alternatives.why_not_duplicate_valid: Held certificate has a distinct lifecycle from one-cycle valid, avoiding a deliberately identical duplicate valid flop. New command clears old authorization before its delayed child delivery.

alternatives.benefit: Preserves explicit stale-tag filtering even outside the reachable invariant and breaks the child cancellation cone at a new edge.
alternatives.cost: Adds one private kill edge. Public masks and masked request-ready paths already prevent new external accepted scratch/reference requests, but private replay/staging activity may advance for one more edge. Must extend admission/drain fence until the actual child kill is consumed.
alternatives.dataflow: Retain old combinational base_abort observable and tag comparator; register its qualified private pulse before driving child_abort=abort_packet||registered_matched_peer_kill. External abort stays direct.
alternatives.name: Extra registered matched-child-kill edge
alternatives.old_checker_conflict: Existing peer before/after hooks key on base_abort and require cancellation on that exact edge. Retaining observable base_abort while delaying actual child kill fails these unchanged timing/counter oracles; it cannot be called an unchanged-contract optimization. Requires a separately declared latency adapter with original oracles retained and strengthened real pulse/debt checks, not a silent checker relaxation.

existing_tests.coverage: 64 command flag/poison variants; accepted-undelivered reset and abort; held start; partial/full/cache-start priority; 7 prepared child fault masks; explicitly injected stale private kill after new offer; prepared fe→ff frontier/reset; actual accepted scratch/reference physical drain.

critical_stale_probe.body: b.offer(); T(base_kill_valid)=1; T(base_kill_owner)=T(owner_sequence)-1; b.poison(); b.tick(); need(T(owner_delivered)&&!T(base_abort),...); b.abort();
critical_stale_probe.meaning: Intentionally violates the reachable invariant to test defensive stale-private-pulse handling. Retain unchanged. It must not silently be excluded or made vacuous by a comparator-removal claim.

existing_tests.v115_peer: Both115501/115502 passed original8 peer cases plus6 parent pending kills,14 full retries/seed. Checks same-owner registered real kill, exact physical reply retirement, private queued/pending refill cancellation counts and original canonical bytes.

path_causality.alias_caution: mode_store/reconstruct_lookup_rsp/cache_count aliases in the synthesis path can result from cross-hierarchy logic merging. Confirm actual carry-chain inputs include base_kill_owner/current-sequence and output reaches producer abort before changing source.
path_causality.required_confirmation: Wait for routed max path. Read DCP all_fanin/get_pins of the comparator endpoint and CARRY S/CI inputs; retain startpoint set, Boolean/LUT INIT and mapped nets. Distinguish an equality cone from frontier/addition or mode-store lookup bounds before claiming a causal cut.
path_causality.source_cone: owner_sequence feeds its increment/start-ready frontier comparison and the private base_kill_owner equality. accepted_start is command_pending based, so the public command frontier reaches children only through a register. Of these source uses, the direct combinational path from sequence into child parser cancellation is base_abort equality. This makes the comparator hypothesis strong at RTL level.

proposed_new_tests: Actual inverse and reconstruction peer fault births under scratch write/read replies before/with/after kill; original same-owner kill, all finite physical ledgers and canonical retries retained.
Actual queued plus pending replay fault; birth and consume counts must be nonzero and exact; no vacuous certificate-only safety proof.
Original stale private valid/retired-owner injection after command_accept unchanged, plus pre-edge masking and unchanged child frame snapshot; full retry.

Real no-owner abort, accepted-undelivered abort/reset, held external abort, partial/full cache abort/rearm and coincident start/cache cases, with source-independent accepted/delivered/canceled conservation.
Private injection alone must not set certificate; fresh real matched kill must set and consume it. Stale old epoch/tag following new command must remain ignored.
Prepared fe→ff sequence frontier and reset, with no outstanding physical operation at the fixture; no credit beyond ff, real kill tag ff, reset returns known empty certificate.

For delayed alternative only, abort/reset on each added stage; exact one extra private kill edge, no external request acceptance, bounded private debt drain and blocked new credit until child kill consumption.

reachable_invariant.cache_and_no_owner: Preload operations and no-owner abort do not change sequence. No-owner abort may intentionally create a matching kill. Cache rearm returns credit after the pulse; it cannot create a mismatched tag.
reachable_invariant.command_concurrency: A command acceptance is mutually exclusive with both kill births by reset/abort and if/else priority. An already-high valid is cleared on the same edge as any sequence change, so no old valid survives into the new sequence.
reachable_invariant.proof: For next_valid=1 exactly one real birth executes, capturing next_owner=current_sequence while next_sequence is unchanged. Every branch changing next_sequence leaves next_valid=0. All other branches default next_valid=0. Thus the implication holds one step after any actual transition, without relying on liveness, owner_open, fault priority, or credit assumptions.
reachable_invariant.scope: Actual sequential RTL transitions after a reset/known state edge; arbitrary public input combinations. Deliberate backdoor forcing of private registers is excluded.
reachable_invariant.wrap: start_ready disables acceptance at ffffffff. fe→ff acceptance produces valid0; later kills capture ff. Reset simultaneously returns sequence0 and valid0. Equality proof does not rely on modular arithmetic.

timing_evidence.limits: Synthesized estimated path only. Arbitrary merged hierarchy net names do not establish source algebra or a routed timing fix.
